anna-sec: Heads-up: proposing an "access cadence" for temporary admin grants and a canonical KMS->owner mapping. Want feedback before I open a PR to automate enforcement.
ben-iam: SGTM. Can you sketch the cadence? Quarterly for everything might be risky for high-value keys.
anna-sec: Proposal sketch: critical KMS keys -> monthly review; production-facing service-admin roles -> 30-day rotating temp grants; infra/admins with low blast radius -> quarterly. Prioritize by exposure + blast radius.
chloe-sre: Monthly for critical keys sounds right. Do we have owner metadata in KMS today? last run had ~40% missing owner tags.
derek-crypto: We can standardize a mapping document in infra-config: YAML table mapping key ARN -> owner emails + last_rotation_ts + linked svcacct. Machine-readable so scripts can merge.
anna-sec: Plan: run KMS inventory job, merge with owner registry, produce an evidence artifact (CSV + JSON) that the automation uses to open PRs for missing owners and to tag review cadence.
ajay-eng: Question: how do we handle active incidents where temp elevations are needed beyond expiry? auto-snooze or manual extend?
anna-sec: Good call. Proposal: incident hold flag with audit annotation and TTL. Default behavior: elevations auto-expire; incident hold allows up to 72h extension but requires explicit approver and a linked incident ticket. No silent indefinite snoozes.
security-bot: alert: recent vuln triage (#V-2026-211) required emergency temp admin for 8h — recorded by derek-crypto.
derek-crypto: I logged approval in PagerDuty and added the note to the incident doc (links: https://redwood/incident/V-2026-211).
ben-iam: We should ensure incident-related elevations get a dedicated column in the access audit table with links to the incident and approver identity. That makes postmortem + compliance evidence straightforward.
anna-sec: Action items: 1) derek-crypto to draft YAML mapping schema and example. 2) ben-iam to prototype owner-merge script and sample outputs. 3) ajay-eng to sketch elevation rollback/playbook for incident holds. 4) chloe-sre to run inventory job and share sample artifacts. 5) I'll draft the automation RFC and runbook. Target: two-week pilot.
chloe-sre: :thumbsup: I'll kick off the inventory job now and post the sample S3 artifact (will include `kms-describe-keys` output + tags).
ajay-eng: One more: staging-only encryption keys — include in monthly critical list?
derek-crypto: Staging keys should be non-critical tier but still need owner metadata and a quarterly spot-check. Keep critical cadence for prod keys only.
anna-sec: OK. If no blockers I will file the RFC tomorrow morning and link this thread. Ping me here if you see compliance/regulatory edge cases I missed.
